caseNameFull: Southern Pacific Company v. John Newman
summary: Error to the Superior Court of Los Angeles County, State of California.
attorneys: Mr. Henry T. Gage, Mr. William I, Gilbert, Mr. Wm. F. Herrin, Mr. Henley C. Booth and Mr. C. F. R: Ogilby for plaintiff in error. Mr. Frank A. Jeffers for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial *581Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.

Mr. Henry T. Gage, Mr. William I, Gilbert, Mr. Wm. F. Herrin, Mr. Henley C. Booth and Mr. C. F. R: Ogilby for plaintiff in error. Mr. Frank A. Jeffers for defendant in error.
